examples.en: He has a clear conscience.
The sky is clear today.
The thief said he had a clear conscience now.
examples.zh: 小偷说他现在问心无愧。

examples.en: A clear conscience makes you sleep well.
Sam had lost his wallet.
There is little money in my wallet.
He was taking his savings to the post office.
She keeps her savings in the bank.
The wallet was found by one of the villagers.
examples.zh: 钱包被一个村民捡到了。

examples.en: The villagers were very friendly.
Sam Benton was the local butcher.
examples.zh: 萨姆·本顿是当地的屠户。

examples.en: The butcher sells fresh meat.
The wallet was wrapped up in newspaper.
She wrapped the present in nice paper.
examples.zh: 她用漂亮的纸把礼物包了起来。

examples.en: The wallet was wrapped up in newspaper.
Father is reading the newspaper.
The wallet contained half the money.
The book contains many pictures.
There was a note in the wallet.
He left a note on the desk.
The note said, 'Only 50 per cent a thief.'
examples.zh: 纸条上写着：“只是个百分之五十的小偷。”

examples.en: Eighty per cent of the students passed the exam.
examples.zh: 百分之八十的学生通过了考试。

examples.en: The last note said, 'I am 100 per cent honest now!'
examples.zh: 最后一张纸条上写着：“我现在是百分之百的正直人了！”

examples.en: He is an honest man.
He was taking his savings to the post office.
The post office is next to the bank.
A large sum of money had been lost.
He paid a large sum for the house.
examples.zh: 他花了一大笔钱买这幢房子。

examples.en: Sam Benton was the local butcher.
examples.zh: 萨姆·本顿是当地的屠户。

examples.en: Sam Benton found his wallet outside his front door.
examples.zh: 萨姆·本顿在大门外发现了自己的钱包。

examples.en: The wallet was not returned to him.
Please return the book to the library.

sentences.en: The whole village soon learnt that a large sum of money had been lost.
sentences.zh: 整个村子很快知道，有一大笔钱丢失了。

sentences.en: Sam Benton, the local butcher, had lost his wallet while taking his savings to the post office.
sentences.zh: 当地的屠户萨姆·本顿在把存款送往邮局的途中，丢失了钱包。

sentences.en: Sam was sure that the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers.
sentences.zh: 萨姆确信钱包一定是被某个村民捡到了。

sentences.en: Three months passed, and then one morning, Sam found his wallet outside his front door.
sentences.zh: 三个月过去了，一天早晨，萨姆在自己的大门外发现了那只钱包。

sentences.en: It had been wrapped up in newspaper and it contained half the money he had lost, together with a note.
sentences.zh: 钱包是用报纸包着的，里面装着他丢失的一半的钱，还有一张纸条。

article.en: The whole village soon learnt that a large sum of money had been lost.
article.zh: 整个村子很快知道，有一大笔钱丢失了。

article.en: Sam Benton, the local butcher, had lost his wallet while taking his savings to the post office.
article.zh: 当地的屠户萨姆·本顿在把存款送往邮局的途中，丢失了钱包。

article.en: Sam was sure that the wallet must have been found by one of the villagers.
article.zh: 萨姆确信钱包一定是被某个村民捡到了。

article.en: But it was not returned to him.
Three months passed, and then one morning, Sam found his wallet outside his front door.
article.zh: 三个月过去了，一天早晨，萨姆在自己的大门外发现了那只钱包。

article.en: It had been wrapped up in newspaper and it contained half the money he had lost, together with a note.
article.zh: 钱包是用报纸包着的，里面装着他丢失的一半的钱，还有一张纸条。

article.en: The note said, 'A thief, yes, but only 50 per cent a thief!'
article.zh: 纸条上写着：“是小偷，没错，但只是个百分之五十的小偷！”

article.en: Two months later, some more money was sent to Sam with another note.
article.zh: 两个月后，又有人给萨姆寄来了一些钱，还附了一张纸条。

article.en: In time, all Sam's money was paid back in this way.
article.zh: 渐渐地，萨姆的钱全都以这种方式还清了。

article.en: The last note said, 'I am 100 per cent honest now!'
article.zh: 最后一张纸条上写着：“我现在是百分之百的正直人了！”
